【2023年私の叶えたいゴール】
 

lululemonさんにご招待いただいた　
2023年自分のゴールを決めるという特別なイベント。 

正直に言います。自分と向き合うことが辛くて、イベントが終わってからも、しばらくゴールを考えることから逃げていました。

当日に絞り出した自分のゴールに嘘はないけれど、

本当に私にはそのゴールが達成ができるのだろうか。
途中で挫折してしまうんじゃないか、　
辛いこともたくさん待っているし　
傷つくこともたくさん待っているんじゃないだろうか。

 

今まで色々な困難を乗り越えてきたはずなのに、　
できる！って分かっているはずなのに、
自分自身の中から出てくる不安な感情に完全に　
押しつぶされてしまっていました。 

（そう、だからレポートが全然書けなかった。ごめんなさい。）

　

正直言うと、去年の夏から年明け辺りまでの私は、
・自分が何者なのか
・人の役に立てているのか
・仕事ばかりで家族を犠牲にしてしまって　
　いるのではないかという事への罪悪感　
　

全てのことが苦しくて、その日その日を生きることに精一杯で、　
みんなに表向きでとびっきりの笑顔を作りながらも、　
自分の心だけ置いてけぼりなままな事にすごく苦しんでいた　
期間がありました。もちろん自信もなくしてた。　　
　
逃げてしまえば楽だったかもしれない　
でも私には逃げる勇気がなくて　
決断できる度胸もなくて　
　
　
結局前に進むためにもがくしかなかった。　

　

どうにか、そんな自分から抜け出したくて、　
思い切って一旦、全部捨ててみよう。って思ったのが　

私を変えるきっかけになった気がしています。

　　

キャラがあるから、切っちゃダメと　
言われてきたロングヘアも　
　　

ずっと慣れ親しんだ、情報発信の環境も
　　
　

きっと自分自身の心の変化と、　
その環境がマッチしなくなってきていた、、、　
いや、ある意味自分が少しずつ次のステージへと、
自分でも気づかない間に進化をしてきていたんだと思うんです。　

きっとそれを、どうやって表現していいかがわからなくて、
モヤモヤしていたんだよね。

　
　

でも、当日に絞り出したゴールがやっぱり、　
私の答えの１つでした。　

【ミオトレオンラインレッスン筋友メンバー１５０人の輪】
　
　
　
　

とにかく上部だけじゃない本質を伝えたかった。　

正しい情報はいっぱいあるから、　
別に私がそれを伝えなくたっていいの。　

でも私にしかできない伝え方とか、　
情熱のかけ方があって、それを　
オンライングループレッスンという形で表現をしたくて。　　
　

　

そこに集まってくれた、　
同じ周波数の仲間と、切磋琢磨したかった。
　
　

たくさん話をしたり、
レッスンで体を動かすことを通して、　
みんなの表情がどんどんと輝いて明るくなっていく様子を見て
こんなに胸いっぱいに幸せを感じることってある！？　
ってほど、幸せを感じているんです。
　
　　

そう。だから、これが今の私のゴール。
【ミオトレオンラインレッスン筋友メンバー１５０人の輪】
　
　

一方的に私が、見られているだけじゃなくて、　
実際に顔を見て、声を聞いて、　
あなたを感じて関わっていきたい。　
　

そういった意味での、　
まだ出会った事のない人と、
これから沢山出会いたい！これが私の想いです。　　

そして、これが私自身の悩みと、　
不安を拭い去ってくれるものだと感じています。　
　

もちろんこのほかに、個人的には、　
資格を取るぞー！！！みたいな目標もあるんだけれど、　　
　

今私の中で1番想いが濃いのはココ。

　

2023年。　
筋友の輪を広げて、１人１人を幸せに、
そして私も一緒に幸せになる。　
　
　
　
　
みんなのおかげで　
すごく笑顔が自然に出るようになったよ。

　

たくさんの感謝と共に、
これを今回のレポートとさせていただきます♡

Mall of America, Bloomington, MN

Overview

Mall of America

As America’s largest mall, Mall of America is one of the world’s most famous malls. Known for its 500+ stores, restaurants, Nickelodeon Universe, and other attractions.

Level 3 + 4

Level 4 is very small, stretching from the mall’s rotunda to above the South Food Court. Level 4 is only entertainment and dining venues like B&B Theaters and The Fair on 4.

Level 3 is where a majority of the dining is at Mall of America. It is home to the mall’s two food courts, as well as South Street Dining which is home to sit-down restaurants. The rest of this level is home to entertainment venues and discount department stores.

Level 2 + 1

Being on Level 1 + 2 is a different vibe. These levels feel luxurious, clean, and what Mall of America is hyped up to be.

South Avenue

South Avenue is the section of the mall closest to the Radisson Blu. The stores in South Avenue are the most luxurious in the mall consisting of Burberry and Levi’s. This area is designed after an Italian village.

East Broadway + Central Parkway

These two sections of the mall are very similar. East Broadway is modeled after New York’s Times Square and features tenants like M&M’s. The mall’s famous rotunda is also in this section which holds events throughout the year.

Central Parkway is the mall’s 2015 expansion. This wing has a futuristic design and features popular brands such as H&M.. The JW Marriott is  in this section as well.

North Garden

North Garden is the part of the mall that is modeled after a garden and features a fountain and many trees. In the Garden there are stores like Lush and Crocs.

West Market

West Market is modeled after a grand train station and features many of the mall’s high end brands, similarly to South Avenue, Brands in West Market include Warby Parker and lululemon. 

Overall

Mall of America has a collection of stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues that is unmatched to most of the country’s malls. Each area of the mall has a unique vibe and a curated collection of tenants.

2020年，疫情給大家拋出了一個很大的變化球，把我推往後好幾步路，但我接住了。

那時2020年，我有三個很讓我雀躍的行程：兩個滿額的瑜伽Retreat, 一個辦在峇里島，一個辦在南法阿爾卑斯山；另一個是被lululemon總公司邀請去加拿大滑雪渡假村，參加lululemon Ambassador Summit。

當然，全因為疫情被迫取消了。

在疫情以前，我有蠻大的野心，做什麼都志在必得；但疫情後，磨掉了很多志氣，只求接得住球就好。

但這段期間，給了我很多時間沈澱，開始跟褚士瑩上了線上哲學課，搓破了很多盲點，改變了很多我的價值觀，我才甘願慢下來。而這一「慢」，讓我收穫很大。

至少很明確的讓我撇除了我所不要的，只做讓身心充電的事，只跟讓身心充電的人在一起，只賺或花讓身心充電的錢——然後發現，原來我可以這麼富裕。

今年早決定要把2020年未成行的Retreat，都一一完成，才發現原來我還學不會——計畫趕不上變化——這道理。原本要開的瑜伽師資培訓，因媽媽的手術而耽擱延後，一年的計畫，想要做的事情必須得重新排序。正納悶這一年究竟能塞下多少事的時候， 突然我很久以前在網路上一個訪談中聽到這句很有意思的話：

「做當你中了樂透變成百萬富還願意持續的事，代表你所做的事所給你的價值，不是用錢就可以取代的。」

我決定下半年再重新辦Retreat，夏天先到阿爾卑斯山～！

很榮幸的，讓我邀請到Yoanna Pan 老師一起帶這個Retreat！

自從上次lululemon的「擁抱台北」跟Yoanna一起帶活動的時候，我就覺得我倆合作非常的契合。

Yoanna給我的感覺，非常的沈穩但不失活潑，沒有故作深奧卻也能讓我觀察到，她能夠把自己看得很透。一個可以跟自己和解的人，會是一個覺察很敏銳並富於同理心的人。當然也是我私心想跟這樣的人在一起工作，因為可以讓我身心充電。

讓這麼一個狠角色，來帶領這Retreat的冥想，正念練習，以及非暴力溝通工作坊，實在是適合不過。讓這個Retreat最最最重要的主軸——從心療癒自己，作為很好的奠基。

另一個很重要的療癒原素，就是阿爾卑斯山。

我2019年，因為到這裡參加Simon Park老師的300小時進階師資培訓時，在這裏待了一個半月，每天除了做瑜伽，最愛的就是都打赤腳Hiking爬山，浸泡在冰川留下來的冰湖裡游泳，看著浩瀚的瀑布上因水霧而形成的彩虹下野餐，吃著小農市集買的有機莓果。

這裡的盛夏，因為冰山融化而造成30幾個瀑布，環繞在這個安靜的南法鄉村Sixt-Fer-A-Cheval，這裡的河水乾淨到可以直接飲用。

我帶女兒來歐洲各地旅遊了以後，她最喜歡這裡。她說：“I think this is what good life looks like!” 

是的，大自然可以輕易的誘發出感恩的心。在這裏，你會不自覺的深呼吸的說：「活著真好！」

Embracing your limitations may seem counterintuitive. After all, we live in a culture that values pushing ourselves to the brink of exhaustion and beyond. But the truth is, facing your limitations head-on can be the key to unlocking your true potential and living a life of vitality and purpose.
.
For me, this has meant confronting my own mobility and strength limitations. As a former international-level athlete 🏊🏻‍♂️🇨🇦, I have a habit of constantly pushing my body to its limits. But I've learned that in order to keep moving forward, I have to be honest with myself about what my body is capable of at any given moment.
.
This isn't always easy. It means acknowledging the fear that comes with realising I can't do something I thought I could. But when I face that fear, when I accept my limitations and work with them instead of against them, I'm able to find new ways to challenge myself and grow stronger (not weaker).
.
So I encourage you to do the same. Don't be afraid to learn about your limitations. Embrace them as part of who you are, and use them as a launching pad for new adventures and opportunities. You might just surprise yourself with what you're capable of when you approach life with an open mind and an open heart.

But it’s times like this we have to remember: We will never be perfect. The journey isn’t linear. We just keep getting up and doing our best. 💕

You will never regret a workout, so even if it just 6 minutes - celebrate it! Go you! Next time try a little longer and remain consistent - that’s the key!

|| JUST BE ||

I had a big realization yesterday & can’t stop thinking about how much fear plays a role in me wanting understand things before I choose to accept them. 

And since part my identity is wrapped in being deep, I tend to make things [that are uncomfortable for me] deeper than they need to be, as a way to feel a sense of control in my mind - trying to alleviate the discomfort.

The depth, overthinking, and the reach for answers can be too much, even for myself sometimes.

Some things are just what they are & that’s ok. We don’t always have to reach for a answer or solution or know exactly why right now.

Sometimes we can just trust, EXPERIENCE the magic of life and just BE.

I do love my deep, philosophical mind, but from now on, I’m inspired to be more present, enjoy more, overthink less, and just BE more.

寗寗張這位以小資女著稱的小瑜人平時都穿平價或特價的瑜珈服，這次直接體驗頂標的lululemon，大家不用擔心，我還是會持續神農嚐百草做各個價位品牌評比。但瑜珈服天花板，我只能說lululemon當之無愧啊。

先來說說Like a Cloud Long-Line Bra，以下簡稱雲朵Bra。雲朵Bra顧名思義就是有如雲朵般輕盈柔和的Bra，輕盈和柔軟真的沒話說，親膚性非常高，肩帶和整體都沒有壓迫感。動作下服貼度也很好，肩帶不會亂跑，下胸固定佳。唯一小小缺點是因為太過輕薄，胸型輪廓會比較明顯，會擔心看到點點輪廓的，建議加胸貼！（這在試穿當下Wendy都有仔細分析利弊給我聽，但我穿上實在太愛雲朵Bra了，我當下就決定是它了）雲朵Bra是我目前穿過第一名舒服好穿的運動Bra🥇

再來是lululemon Align ™ HR Pant 24”，Align ™是lululemon的暢銷系列，是一種彷彿奶油絲滑的質地，像是第二層皮膚般的面料。以上是lululemon的說法，但寗寗張證明了這絲毫沒有誇大其辭。這褲子穿上會感動到想流淚，我先替大家跟lululemon致謝，這完全是為瑜珈人設計的褲子啊！穿了比沒穿更舒服，逼近絲襪的輕薄，卻有很好的包覆性，給予雙腳適量的支撐，卻又不過度壓迫緊繃，特別是小腿的弧形剪裁，小腿肚肚第一次被不過份的愛擁抱著🥺沒有🐫峯，沒有🐫峯，沒有🐫峯，很重要所以說三次。此款Align ™褲子雖然款式偏基本，但有多種顏色、尺寸和長度可供搭配挑選。延展性極佳，套一句獵人西索的招牌：伸縮自如的愛呀。小小缺點是實測過程中，我的褲頭還是會因動作變換而被拉下和回捲，這大概也是寗寗張目前買各家瑜珈褲碰到最大的問題。

最後的Perfectly Oversized Crop Crew，是喜歡穿運動服外出寗寗張的好朋友，套上一件，冷冷的天也可以有你運動ootd！材質上還是貫徹lululemon的舒適標竿，屌打一般的外出服，穿過一次你就懂我在說什麼了！所以，不管你愛不愛運動，喜歡休閒打扮的朋友，推薦你一定要去試試lululemon！

Gate River Run Recap

Ok first things first, it got HOT and things got sweaty. 

I came into the the race feeling pretty good fitness wise, was I in the best fitness shape I’ve ever been for this race…no. However, I felt the best mentally coming into this years Gate and hoped the mental would carry me through for something special. So my goal was to shoot for sub 50min (5:20min/mi pace) but once the weather on the morning showed temps over 75. I adjusted my realistic goal to be sub 52min (5:35min/mi pace and about :15sec slower). In order to achieve this I needed to start with the pace controlled and around 5:40-5:45. 

As it unfolded I hit 5:45 for the first 6 miles. Felt pretty much that I had my gears stuck. At this point I shifted my goal once again, this time to 54 minutes. If you need a pro tip, allowing yourself to adjust goals within a race helps keep you in the fight. 

I had an athlete, who ran up next to me around the 6mi/10k mark, encouraging me to roll with him to catch the few others just ahead of us. We rolled the next mile and caught three of them but once I turned onto Atlantic Blvd he had pulled away and I had nothing extra at that time to keep up. 

Once I hit the bridge I started to gain some energy. My focus was on keeping a steady and smooth effort on the UP and once I would crest the top I was going to lean on my downhill skills as my secret weapon. I was able to overtake a couple other athletes on the downhill but once I hit the flat and the final fee hundred meters to go I had no extra speed and no finishing kick but felt very proud of the effort for the day. I had gone through some injuries post Thanksgiving and at least today felt no issues arise. 

I’m thankful for the time off I’ll be taking to recover and then I look forward to a strong build for the fall.

As my birthday rolls around this wknd, I pause to celebrate a win. I am not a celebrity or the offspring of a major fashion brand owner. I did not major in fashion design and I don’t know the owners of any sports teams. Basically, I didn’t get any easy, breezy ticket. 

I grew up with a dad who loved basketball and sports in general, a mom who always wore the latest fashion trend and a childhood love for playing dress up. I danced in the NBA and got paid $7.64/hour. Perhaps it was destiny and a bit of blind ambition that created the fashion brand I own today. KadyLuxe designs retail collections for the largest sports teams in the nation, and we compete with the likes of Nike and lululemon. 

I remember when all these sweet things in my reality lately were just a pipe dream. 

I remember when I had no clue how to design apparel much less manufacture and had to humbly teach myself. 

I remember when an engineer stole all of our kickstarter seed money. 

I remember feeling envious of entrepreneurs who made it to the level of success I have today. 

I remember when I was faced with the challenge of almost filing bankruptcy.

I remember when sports teams and colleges shut down in 2020 and we lost all of our wholesale business. 

I remember when I thought I had to do it all alone. 

Perhaps if I had a looking glass and saw what it took to create a clothing brand from nothing I’d have opted out, but that’s the beauty we don’t know the ending. We just believe in ourselves and make the next best decision. 

It doesn’t have to be hard, but if it is and you prevail 🙌. Stand proud. My journey could have been shorter and easier, but there were many lessons I needed to learn. 

Today KadyLuxe got asked to design for our first WNBA client. 🙌🏀 ⛹🏽‍♀️This year we signed with Fanatics, Ohio State, Notre Dame, LA Lakers, Phoenix Suns, Sacramento Kings, Denver Nuggets, and many more iconic sports teams. We are a loved brand of the Dallas Cowboys. It’s March 1, and we’ve booked more revenue than any year end past. AND exciting news…WE ARE HIRING! Continue reading into comments…

期待更多的循環創新。

It’s been three weeks since my favorite season of the year ended, and I’m just now emotionally recovering from it. 

There have been very few things in my life that I can confidently say I feel called to by my Maker. But I’ve discovered basketball is one of those. For some reason, nothing fulfills me more than playing, coaching, and being around this sport. And since I’m not very good at the first one any more, I find myself pouring more into the latter two lately. 

This season brought back feelings I haven’t felt in a long time. So much fun. So much joy. So much pride in seeing this particular group of boys develop so much and break through so many barriers. And so much heartache ending the season with a loss in the championship. 

But even in that there are so many lessons to be learned and experiences to cherish. These boys, my assistant coach, the parents - they all continue to teach me valuable lessons just as much as I teach them. This was a special group I’ll never forget. 

I think the only part I enjoy more than barking lines at the kids I simply stole from Coach Summitt, is the quality time I get with my son over something we both seem passionate about. I thank God for that. 

And like any father that’s ever coached their son, I’m still learning how to navigate that fine and delicate line. I still mess it up all the time, but this is where he actually coaches me. And I feel like we’re both getting better at it, together.

For our final team feature for #BlackHistoryMonth, we’re shining a light on Jonathan. Jonathan has led a treasured OG class gem, FIND YOUR FLO in our space almost since the very beginning.

I am… a connector. I thrive in environments that force me to share, grow, and repeat. I think that process never stops, you only get better at it as time goes on. Being an entrepreneur to my core, I take the time to notice gaps in our community, and strive to have those spaces filled. I preach and praise the concept of collaboration over competition. I am passionate about creating a world that has fewer barriers for my kids than when I was a kid.

Find me… as I balance between being an introvert and an extrovert. I value my alone time, my time to reset and debrief. On the flip side, I love big energy. Some people would say I have too much. I love being with loved ones and sharing space with those who share the same sentiment. You can find me every Sunday at MOVE EAST from 4-4:45pm for a beginner meditation session, FIND YOUR FLO.

As for my work life… I am the co-founder of @flomeditation, the founder of @fullspectrumtalent, and the Community Key Leader at @lululemon Spring Garden. I try to be authentically involved in whatever I can, as much as I can. I have so much love for the city that has welcomed me, and the past 5 years have been a beautiful journey of sharing and growing.

It’s important to note that as #BlackHistoryMonth draws to a close, it doesn’t mean the work stops here. To see more inclusion and representation within our communities, we acknowledge it takes a consistent effort to actively listen, learn, and show up as an ally – each and every day.

There’s no way around it, some decisions are tough. 
.
I have been training since September with a singular goal in mind, a trip to the World Masters Indoor Championships in Poland.  I’ve been avoiding this post, but now that I’ve received all my deposits back, it’s feeling quite real and unavoidable.  With Poland leading Europe’s response to the Russian invasion in Ukraine it did not feel right for me, or my family, to travel there.  I remained motivated with the hope that things would improve overseas, but they have only escalated.  I waited until the last possible minute to make the final decision not to go.  Things change when you have a little one at home and when your decision can impact your loved ones.  I felt the weight of their worry and concern.  I had to do what felt right in my gut for us. 
.
I’m pretty devastated.  I’ll have to wait two years for the next indoor world championship.  I’ve been feeling pretty lost without a big goal to guide me.  So for now, I’m leaning on my pure love of running and the process.  That will always be enough at the core to continue, but I will be looking for new goals to motivate me.  I’m driven to always improve and find the best version of myself.  Nothing will change that.  Thank you to everyone who has supported me on this journey, it doesn’t stop here.

Rest is medicine. It is pause and a breaker of cycles. Rest is a space to dream and receive downloads. May we find rest, joy, ease, and strength as we need, on our own terms. 🖤✨

I personally LOVE the #classicalpilates swan variation. However, as someone who has trained teachers in the classical work for many years I know first hand many people DO NOT love it 🤪. For me the classical Swan is perfect for my arthritic low back because my knees can drop below my pelvis height during the extension peak of the exercises making it less intense on my low back. Because of the arthritis in my low back I cannot perform many exercises of the classical Mat Swan variations but it’s still important for me to maintain strong posterior chain.  Here are a few of my favorite contemporary Swan variations that I like to throw into my classes that are gentle on my back yet still a great way to strengthen the back and core. It’s so important to include a variety of posterior chain movements into your classes to create a true full body workout. In my experience Extension is probably the #1 neglected plain of movement in modern Pilates classes.  No matter what variations you teach the same basic Pilates principles apply; always draw the abdominals in the the spine while lifting from the pelvic floor and connecting under the shoulder girdle to maintain a string supported spine. Today is Rare Disease Day and I wanted to take a moment and reflect on why I started running all of these crazy long distance events.

My niece Cori was diagnosed with Metachromatic Leukodystrophy(MLD)in late 2013. 

By June 2014, she had lost all of her gross and fine motor skills including the ability to walk with a walker, sit up, hold toys, eat by mouth, and speak. She spoke her last words just a few days after Easter in 2014.

For the next seven years MLD deteriorated her peripheral nervous system and the white matter of her brain, severing the lines of communication between her brain and the rest of her body at an alarming rate. There is no cure for symptomatic children like Cori, and after periods of rapid progression they typically pass away between 5 and 8 years of age. Our family was lucky to have Cori in our lives for 9 years.

There have been recent developments in treatment that can help save children with MLD prior to becoming symptomatic. It’s critical that MLD be added to newborn screening procedures to determine if treatment may help.

Every little step you take in the right direction MATTERS! You don’t need to devote hours out of your busy day sweating buckets to reap all the physical and mental health benefits of exercise. Just 30-minutes of moderate exercise five times a week is enough. And even that can be broken down into two 15-minute or even three 10-minute exercise sessions if that’s easier. #manageablemondays 

If you don’t have time for 15 or 30 minutes of exercise, or if your body tells you to take a break after 5 or 10 minutes, for example, that’s okay, too. Start with 5- or 10-minute sessions and slowly increase your time. The more you exercise, the more energy you’ll have, so eventually you’ll feel ready for a little more. The key is to commit to some moderate physical activity—however little—on most days. As exercising becomes a habit, you can slowly add extra minutes or try different types of activities. If you keep at it, the benefits of exercise will begin to pay off.

你嘅瑜伽練習有冇令你變好呢？

我初初開始練習瑜伽時，係因為我想要一個唔需要辛苦嘅運動去減肥🙈。 當然，隨住我嘅練習一年一年咁過去，我發覺我得到嘅嘢，俾我當初想像嘅要多好多好多。如果你仲係諗住瑜伽可以令你變成幾大力，幾柔軟，hips 有幾開，做到幾勁幾多variations之類，你簡直係入寶山而空手而回⋯⋯

問一問你自己以下嘅問題，睇吓瑜伽有冇令你進步過？

1）你會唔會比以前冇咁容易發脾氣？

我哋每人都有一個（甚至幾個）自己最憎做嘅瑜伽體式。因為呢個體式會令到自己感覺唔舒適唔叻 - 無論係身體上或心理上。你有冇學懂到，唔舒適可能只係短暫性嘅或者係可以容忍嘅？ 你有冇一去到最憎嘅式子（每個人討厭嘅嘢都唔同，每個人嘅道場都唔一樣)，會唔會多咗一份忍耐，少咗即刻發老脾劈低乜都唔做嘅定力？

2）你嘅接受能力有冇比之前高咗？

上堂時老師話，你今日要做幻椅(chair pose) 5分鐘，你嘅即時反應係「頂，冇可能！」定係「吓！試吓先啦！」你選擇去正面咁迎接問題？還是負面咁去拒絕先呢？拒絕係100%無可能。你對人生嘅展望就係100%無可能嗎？ 瑜伽有冇令你覺得，你其實係有能力嘅呢？你一年前以為冇可能做到嘅嘢，今日比一年前有進步嗎？ 

3）你會唔會覺得自己物欲冇咁重？買少咗嘢？

瑜伽有冇令你覺得，心情好並唔係因為你今日着住上堂嗰套lululemon有幾靚，個手袋有幾限量，又或者你之後去嗰間餐廳有幾多粒星…… 心情好，可能係你因為發現自己原來有能力撐起自己，甚至係隔離嗰個人。你發現咗令自己真正開心有能量嘅嘢唔同咗咁囉。

4）你識唔識得煞停自己去聽吓人哋講乜？
我哋成日都stuck 咗喺自己個腦入邊，自己諗嘅嘢就以為係真嘅，所有事都無限放大。一有唔順心就諗到人哋幾衰幾衰咁……。瑜伽練習就係要叫你停一停慢慢嚟先，比時間你自己去學識唔係所有嘢都係你個腦入邊咁諗嘅。慢落嚟，識停低，先至可以聽到及睇到其他嘅可能性，聽到及領會到其他人講乜嘢。

咁瑜伽有冇令到你改變到呢？ 喺呢個世界上，其實我哋冇一個人係完美嘅，大家都係跌跌撞撞，盲摸摸咁樣去學做人。希望你唔好太過為難自己，學會從容一點點咁去面對自己人生。

This morning I attended a goals and vision workshop with my Lululemon community. One of my short term goals that I listed was to keep my scale out of my bathroom(it left during our bathroom Reno) Now, I know I’ve said this before, and I’ll say it a hundred times, bc eventually my scale will creep back in. We were asked if anyone wanted to share, and I did. I’ve always been transparent about the fact that I’ve suffered from an eating disorder since a very young age. I am an open book about it. But when I started talking I felt a prick in my eyes, and then they started to fill up with tears. That was completely unexpected. Im strong. I haven’t had a relapse in 7 or maybe even 8 years now. Turns out it was therapeutic to talk about it again, and even though I’m recovered in the sense that I’m not currently spiraling out of control, that doesn’t mean that it’s not something that I struggle with. It made me realize that no matter how much time passes it will always be a part of my life. I will always be healing from the trauma that caused the eating disorder in the first place. 
While I feel that I’m in a good place, I still can’t let go of my crutch even though I so badly want to. But today, I felt something. Something that makes me feel like I should start using this small little platform that I have to bring awareness to eating disorders, mental health associated with ED, healing from ED with movement, and nutrition. 
If you’re someone suffering, know that you’re not alone. There are so many people out there fighting this with you. I am by no means a medical professional, but if you ever need someone to talk to, know that I’m here. When I’m feeling like I’m headed down a slippery  slope I tune into my breath an repeat I Am statements. 
I AM strong 
I AM more than a number on a scale 
I AM enough 
I AM healing from my trauma 
I AM loved
My scale does not define me 

I want to say thank you to my Lululemon family for letting me be vulnerable this morning. And thank you to my studio family for always supporting me. I’m never going to pretend like I have it all figured out. I’m just trying to figure out life like everyone else, and I love that you love me anyway❤️

How often do I change my workouts? Oh great question. Let’s take a look. 

Here’s the thing: it depends

I’d argue that depending on your training status (beginner or advanced), your goals, and your availability, this answer could be different. 

When I post online I’d assume it looks like I’m doing a different workout every session. 

If you watch these clips long enough I’ve attached my workout from last week to the one I did this last weekend so you can see what’s changed.

All movements except 1 changed (the plyometric): although the goal of the movement stayed the same. (to prime for squats) 

Besides that: 

My squat weight went up, reps went down, same RPE. 

My lunges weight went up, reps stayed the same. Felt stronger this week. 

Push-ups kept the weight and sets/reps exactly the same. 

Chin-ups: kept the exact same sets/reps. 

A couple things to note: I would consider myself to be more advanced in the gym with 5+ years of serious work building a base of muscle, functionality, and strength. I’m in a sense “where I want to be” but enjoy picking up new goals…

Occasionally I’ll try a new movement and never use it again, 

Sometimes I’ll add in a movement and incorporate it 1-2 times a week for months on end. 

The things you want to get better at: do them often, and do them good. 

In terms of the actual periodization (managing the work load, sets, reps, weight): that’s a different story for a different day. Like you might be wondering why I added weight this week to my squats but not my lunges 😂🤔

Okay idk if this is helpful but just wanted to remind you that it’s okay to explore movements and try new things if that’s what your goal is but if you’re wanting to get BETTER or STRONGER or FASTER, etc… then doing the same things again and again is gonna be the best way (as long as it’s modified to you) 

For my programs click the link in my bio: I recommend my third base program if you’re more advanced and my first base program for a good starting point. 

HAPPY DAYYY

While it requires great strength to change our habit patterns and update the framework of our thoughts, we can only do so much on our own. There comes a point when what we need is beyond our reach and we can only be carried where we need to go. This is why yoga is a mix of effort and surrender, hard work and faith. Sunny SoCal kids woke up to teeny tiny snow flurries ❄️ and it made our whole morning! We bundled up and rushed out to play and I had a moment standing in the middle of the park watching the kiddos giggle; I AM SO DANG THANKFUL for my wellness, my health, my energy, my happy hormones, easily slipping on clothes I haven’t tried in awhile and knowing they’ll fit, not having to deal with breakouts, headaches, bloating and gut issues anymore, being able to keep up with my kids energy and my pup’s endless energy! BUT IT WASN’T ALWAYS THIS WAY…

When I was 15 I got pinned with a diagnosis of fibromyalgia and thank heavens my Dad took me to his holistic doctor for a second option. That incredible man pulled a prescription pad out and where I thought he’d write medications like the rheumatologist did, he instead wrote: 

Go in the sunshine
Drink lots of water 
Eat real food
Laugh with your friends 
Meditate more 
Move your body 

Believe your body has the power to heal ✨

I had a choice: I could take the meds from the first doctor or I could try the whole idea of natural approaches. Needless to say I went with the second choice and 23 years later I’m still preaching it! 

While modern medicine is necessary and can be life saving, it all too often makes us forget how much we can actually control and heal on our own. 

This is a reminder to give your body the opportunity to heal! Make the changes to allow your body to shift into the Nourished + Thriving cycle.

It’s hard to draft the perfect words to express my love for Kaua’i. Starting with my great-grandma who worked in the Hanalei taro patches to my grandma being born at the Princeville Plantation house to my dad being the biggest wave magnet I know at our favorite wave :)— I wanted to honor home to the best of my ability in this film without over doing it with dialog. It really is a place that brings more of a feeling than words can describe. I am happy we got to share such an integral part of my life in this film, the reason I am who I am is because of where I grew up. The community, the waves, the environment.

Lately I have been spending more time at home. As I have allowed myself to slow-down from such a fast pace competitive career I have especially been focused on watching my dad’s connection to the waves here. His approach to surfing is really incomparable- I owe a lot of what I know from both my parents passion for the ocean. Some things truly run through your DNA, and I am thankful my love for surfing is one of them.

나의 달리기 ‘도구’들

1. 러닝화.
브랜드 가리지 않고 번갈아 가면서 신는다. 올버즈, 아식스, 아디다스, 호카, 알트라 등의 로드&트레일 러닝화들을 번갈아 가면서 신고 있다.

발볼이 편한걸 선호하다 보니, 알트라, 올버즈, 호카(와이드핏)을 주로 신는다. 개인적으로 알트라가 상당히 편하다.

2. 시계.
카시오 시계를 쭈욱 쓰고 있다. 달릴 때 나의 페이스를 알려주지 않아서 내가 스스로 직감적으로, 호흡을 관찰하며 페이스 조절을 하고, 무리하지 않을 수 있어서 좋다.

종종 핸드폰을 들고 스트라바를 키고 달리기도 하는데 요새는 뭔가 더 가볍게 (both body and mind) 달리고 싶어서 카시오 시계 하나만 차고 달리는 날들이 많다.

3. 요가매트.
요가, 스트레칭을 위한 요가매트 하나는 꼭 있어야지. 룰루레몬 앰배서더를 거의 5년차 하고 있는데, 그래서 하는 말이 아니라 룰루레몬 요가매트는 상당히 퀄리티가 좋다. (한국에서 다양한 요가원에서 다양한 요가 매트를 경험해봤는데 결론은 요가매트는 당연 @lululemonkr @lululemon )

4. 캐틀벨. 마사지건. 푸쉬업도구.
근력과 이완을 위한 도구들. 요새 어나와 서로 마사지건 해주는 것에 심취하여있다.

Lift each other up.

In this Hightech-Tiktok-IG-Reels-Post'vid world, young people aren't getting the same quality social interactions that were so common even just a few years ago. Social media doesn't make anything easier, aside from helping hide your most genuine self from the world. 

So many people, especially youth and young adults, are especially vulnerable to having their self-esteem attacked not just in-person but also online. We need to make sure we spread messages of the importance of INCLUSIVITY, KINDNESS and ACCEPTANCE.

It's very important to support programs that teach young people empathy, kindness, compassion and that foster self-esteem. Pink Shirt Day is one way that you can help provide support to anti-bullying initiatives with 100% of the proceeds going towards helping youth and young people build up a healthy self-esteem.

Making the choice to intervene and say something when you see an act of bullying can put a stop to it within seconds!

Continue to lift up those around you, it could mean the world of difference to them.

* vulnerable post * 
I was gifted this pink shirt from my workplace in honour of Pink Shirt Day / Anti Bullying Day. 
A day to stand against bullying - first celebrated in honour of a small town in Nova Scotia and by a random act of kindness. 
I wear my pink shirt today proudly as a reminder and as a stand personally against bullying. 
I’m sharing a time I was targeted and bullied online, shockingly by a fellow yoga teacher in our community. 
✨
It was December 2021 - my Dad had recently left the hospital after almost passing and spending a month in care, 
I had shared a picture of a Christmas gift I was given from my supporters at Lululemon PG as their Yoga Ambassador. 
The person verbally attacked me and the photos that were taken by a beautiful photographer - photos taken at a time where I was possibly saying goodbye to my Dad, along side that - given an amazing opportunity to work with Lululemon within our community. 
I erased the comments and blocked the person from as much social media I could, but the damage had been done. 
Not to my ego - to me, to my deepest self - my heart, me as Denise - a mom, caregiver, daughter, friend, sister, woman and Yogi. 
I made excuses for this persons actions - how could they know what I was going through, they didn’t know my decision for taking on the ambassador role, how could they know the personal circumstances of my life at the time - it’s ok - they didn’t know.
It’s not ok. It never is. It never was. 
It never will be. 
Because she didn’t know what was happening for me personally should’ve been even more reason to not say or do what she did. 
✨
Bullying is never ok, online or in person. 
I’ve only ever shared this info with a few people, I have felt so many emotions and feelings around the event, I try to find peace for myself and for her, it’s been over a year and I try everyday. 
✨
I share this story for those that are afraid to share. I share it as a reminder - bullying happens anywhere to anyone. 
✨
The shirt reads “Bidzee c’izu’ / have a good heart “ 
I try - together, let’s try, everyday. 
Thank you for letting me share 💖

یه روز نشستم با خودم فکر کردم ملیحه تا قبل از مرگش چه کارهایی رو دوست‌داره انجام بده،دیدم همیشه دوست‌داشتم که یه ساز یاد بگیرم، و اینکه ورزش تو روتین زندگیم باشه،و … (بقیه‌اش رو بعدا می‌گم🙈)خلاصه این شد که تصمیم‌گرفتم یکبار این فرصت رو به خودم بدم و کلاس گیتار رو شروع کردم،اولش شاید فقط ده‌ثانیه می‌تونستم انگشتام رو روی سیم نگه‌دارم،از پوست انگشت تا ناکجاآبادترین ماهیچه دستم درد می‌گرفت و هزارنفر تو مغزم می‌گفتن ول کن‌ حالا چه کاریه،بشین شادمهرت رو گوش بده🤭ولی من واقعا دوست‌داشتم با همه سختیش یاد بگیرم،و تمرین و تمرین باعث شد هی این زمان رو زیاد کنم و سعی کنم پیشرفت کنم…حالا نکه الان براتون برم رو صحنه اجرا کنم ولی بالاخره در مسیر یادگیریم😅

ورزش رو ولی خیلی تازه شروع کردم،روز اول می‌خواستم یه پلانک برم تا ۳شمردم افتادم زمین،امروز بعد یه هفته تونستم قبل از اینکه پخش زمین شم حداقل تا ۴۵ بشمارم…نمی‌دونم شاید یک‌سال دیگه به نظرم این چیزها خیلی ابتدایی بیاد ولی عوضش یک‌سال پیش هم یه رویا بودن😎

به خودت و پتانسل‌هات اعتماد کن، و کلا ول‌نکن باش! به قول انگلیسی‌زبون‌ها که می‌گن: «تا زمانی که شروع به حرکت نکنی، هیچ‌وقت نمی‌فهمی تا کجا می‌تونی پیش بری!» 💪

Trying to be a happy mommie for my little girl- as I know that the chemicals running through my body also pass through my placenta straight to her. She feels what I feel. The beginning of our attachment
.
.
It’s been a constant reminder to slow down and be intentional with this babe as I chase my soon to be 3 year old around, run a private practice in order to PAY for my own maternity leave and meet all of life’s numerous roles and expectations. There is nothing like motherhood when it comes to testing my boundaries and asking me boldly: “ yes- but what are your priorities? And who gets the best of you- rather than the leftovers of you?” I am forced to answer this question. She forces me too. 
.
.
.
Whether you’re a new momma, an old momma or a want to be momma- it is all the same. TAKE CARE OF YOURSELF
.
.
My intentional self care these days is moving my body 30 min a day (and praising my efforts even though it’s a lazy 30 min!). Eating what I want because I trust she will tell me what she needs. Taking long naps. Having my to do list lowered. Reading goofy books. Going to my prenatal chiropractor and splurging on a facial from @craftedaesthetics. Well- and splurging on some nice #alignleggings from @lululemon (butter on my legs). 🖤
.
.

He was charged and later arraigned on felony retail fraud first-degree, felony identity theft, and resisting and obstructing police.

Birmingham detectives investigated the case and determined the suspects involved were part of a more significant organized retail crime (ORC) team, committing numerous retail frauds throughout the state of Michigan totaling over $140,000.

On 2/17/2023, Birmingham detectives were notified that subjects linked to the same ORC crew had committed another retail fraud at a Detroit lululemon store, stealing approximately $6000.00 in merchandise. After leaving the store, they drove to a business in Detroit and unloaded the clothing.

Birmingham detectives obtained a search warrant for the business and conducted surveillance in conjunction with the Troy Special Investigation (SIU), a multi-jurisdictional task force comprised of officers from the Troy Police Department, Auburn Hills Police Department, Royal Oak Police Department, Bloomfield Township Police Department, and Birmingham Police Department.

Birmingham detectives, Troy SIU, Oakland County Narcotics Enforcement Team (NET), and the South Oakland Narcotics Intelligence Consortium (SONIC) executed the search warrant locating numerous stolen items, including 17 clothing articles from the Birmingham lululemon store and a total value of clothing over $41,000. Also recovered from the business were several illegal guns and stolen appliances from various jurisdictions.

Birmingham detectives obtained a search warrant for the business and conducted surveillance in conjunction with the Troy Special Investigation (SIU), a multi-jurisdictional task force comprised of officers from the Troy Police Department, Auburn Hills Police Department, Royal Oak Police Department, Bloomfield Township Police Department, and Birmingham Police Department.
Birmingham detectives, Troy SIU, Oakland County Narcotics Enforcement Team (NET), and the South Oakland Narcotics Intelligence Consortium (SONIC) executed the search warrant locating numerous stolen items, including 17 clothing articles from the Birmingham lululemon store and a total value of clothing over $41,000. Also recovered from the business were several illegal guns and stolen appliances from various jurisdictions.

Transparency 🐆

For all relationships in my life, romantic, friendships, professional, I like to be transparent and social media is no different for me. 

I always want my platform to be what you see is what your get. I never want to be someone you meet or know in person that is different than the person you get to know here. 

I don’t believe in only sharing the good, the positive and the happy because that’s not real life. But I do bring a good, positive and happy approach to the bad because that is genuinely how I approach any situation. 

But for this Monday I’m here to tell you and to relate with those who may also be going through a “bipolar”  phase. That feeling of being UNSTOPPABLE, like an ultra heavy weight awaiting a featherweight opponent in the absolute, to the next day or even moment, being a featherweight and feeling the pressure of an ultra heavy weight sitting on your chest with no intentions of moving 😅

There is no shame in the “I want to quit” feelings. But there is shame if the action matches the feeling, because I know I’m better than that, and I’m telling you, you are as well. Honor the feeling of wanting to quit and then ask yourself “have I felt this way before?” If you haven’t you’re a big fat liar and if you have… guess what… you didn’t… and look where you are now.

This picture has me so emotional (more emotional than I was when we took it) for so many different reasons.

Yesterday, when I thought we were going to move and breathe, we talked, hugged and cried. We talked about our spaces as Black women, as moms, as dancers, as teenagers, about going through menopause, stress, facing depression and the struggle for time to make it all work. We talked about our culture, our curves, our upbringing, our challenges and where we want to go next. 

And then every BODY (an entire array of shapes and sizes) went in and out of the dressing rooms to find a pair of leggings they loved and felt the best in and were gifted them courtesy of the @lululemon home team here in Huntsville (thanks, y’all!). 

I’m not sure why I tried to shy away from having my ambassador picture as the backdrop (seven months and a million pictures later, it’s still overwhelming) but I’m glad they told me we were doing it because it’s, THEY, are the reason I accepted the ambassadorship in the first place. I am the change and am proud to bridge between what was and what will be. 

If you want to make a change, don’t wait for people to wander through your door. GO TO THEM, meet them where they are, offer what you have and serve with your heart.

This is the beginning of something beautiful in all the ways.

MY TOP TIPS FOR BEGINNERS IN THE GYM 👋🏼

☑️Go in with a set plan - find a structured program/routine that works for you and follow it consistently. When you find a routine you genuinely enjoy, it will be so much easier to stick with long term. Be patient and remember progress isn’t always linear. 

☑️Always prioritize form over weight. Leave the ego behind and remember it’s always you vs. you! 

☑️Stick to the basics! You don’t need fancy exercises to see results. Start with compound movements and add in a few unilateral/accessory exercises.

☑️Apply progressive overload - whether that’s increasing the weight, number of reps, frequency, etc. Don’t be afraid to challenge yourself - you are much stronger than you think. 

☑️ Mobility - incorporating dynamic stretching and mobility into your routine can reduce muscle tension/soreness, decrease risk of injury, improve physical performance, etc. 

☑️ Rest and Recovery - This is SO important. Rest days give your muscles a chance to grow and recover. Your body needs time to repair, rebuild, and reset. 

☑️Nutrition is key! You can’t out-train a bad diet - emphasize whole, nutrient dense foods. Find foods you enjoy that align with your fitness goals. And remember it’s all about balance! I like to follow the 80/20 rule 😊

☑️Always do it for YOU - the best and most successful way to stay consistent in the gym is to always do it for yourself.

Ever get moved by the stillness in your yoga practice? 
The gap between the movement and the hold. 
The moment you hear your breath again. 
The moment your eyes land on one spot with a soft but focused gaze. 
This space tends to be the one I’m eager to land lately. 
Less in the movement of it all and more in the landing to be grounded and supported. 
I move around a lot in my day - sometimes my movement is with full focus and sometimes it is set on auto pilot. 
Both teach me. 
When I’m doing something to complete the things and when I’m doing something to avoid stillness - intentionally and not. 
Both teach me. 
I used to be hard on myself for days I turned on auto pilot. I let the day pass me by doing nothing, yet doing everything.
The more I practice, the more I recognize that it is the time on my mat that got me curious to begin with and it got me understanding my relationship with my movement and my stillness. 
Because of this curiosity, I can appreciate the awareness I have in both. 
The ebb and the flow - no practice is the same, energy is forever moving and so is our attention.

El chatbot Bing AI de Microsoft empieza a amenazar a la gente
La semana pasada, Microsoft anunció el nuevo Bing potenciado por IA: una interfaz de búsqueda que incorpora un chatbot potenciado por un modelo lingüístico que puede ejecutar búsquedas por ti y resumir los resultados, además de hacer todas las otras cosas divertidas que motores como GPT-3 y ChatGPT han estado demostrando en los últimos meses: la capacidad de generar poesía, y chistes, y hacer escritura creativa, y mucho más.
Esta semana, la gente ha empezado a acceder a él a través de la lista de espera. Cada vez parece más que ésta puede ser una de las aplicaciones de la IA más divertidamente inapropiadas que hayamos visto hasta ahora.
Si no has estado atento, esto es lo que ha ocurrido hasta ahora.
 La demo estaba llena de errores
  Empezó a gaslighting personas
  Sufrió una crisis existencial
  Se filtró el mensaje
  Y entonces empezó a amenazar a la gente
La demo estaba llena de errores
La demostración que presentó AI Bing al mundo era realmente convincente: mostraban comparaciones de compras, planificación de itinerarios de viaje y resúmenes de estados financieros.
Entonces Dmitri Brereton hizo una comprobación de los hechos con los ejemplos de la demo.
Dijo que los contras de la "Bissell Pet Hair Eraser Handheld Vacuum" incluían un "cable corto de 16 pies", cuando esa aspiradora no tiene cable en absoluto, y que "es lo suficientemente ruidosa como para asustar a las mascotas", cuando los comentarios en línea señalan que es muy silenciosa.
Recomendaba un bar "rústico y encantador" en Ciudad de México sin señalar que también es uno de los bares gays más antiguos de Ciudad de México.
Lo mejor de todo es que ofrecía un resumen de las finanzas de Gap y las comparaba con las de Lululemon... mientras se inventaba por completo muchas de las cifras. Dimitri observa que "el beneficio diluido por acción de Lululemon es de 2,00 dólares, no de 1,65". ¡No se trata de pequeños errores!

2월 5~6일 그랜드 하얏트 호텔에서 진행된 룰루레몬 앰배서더 트립.
룰루레몬과 저의 시작은 “제가요..? 제가 룰루레몬에 도움이 될까요?” 였어요. 

지난 5월에 컨트랙 사인업 했으니 벌써 9개월이라는 시간이 지났네요. 지난 시간동안 룰루레몬코리아는 제 안의 잠재력을 가능성으로 이끌어주었어요. 

나는 나 스스로를 참 많이 사랑하고 나는 뭐든 할 수 있다고 믿지만, 가끔은 불안과 의심이 드는 순간들이 있잖아요. 룰루레몬은 항상 물음표를 느낌표로 바꿔줬던 것 같아요. 

돌아보니 룰루레몬 팀으로부터 어마무시 하게 큰 사랑을 받았네요. 

연예인이 된 것처럼 스토어에 걸릴 포토슛 촬영도 했고, 챌린지 동기부여 영상도 찍었고, 기업들을 대상으로 하는 클래스도 연결해주었어요. 언제든 도움이 필요하면 서포트 하겠다고 항상 응원을 받아서 얼마나 든든했는지 몰라요. 

날씨가 추울 때, 코로나가 또 유행할 때, 우리의 안부를 진심으로 물어주었고, 기쁜 일이 있을 때는 함께 축하하고 기뻐해줬어요. 

앰배서더 트립을 통해 나는 왜 이 일을 하고 있는가? 나의 목적은 무엇인가? 
나를 들여다 보는 시간을 가졌어요. 제 안의 숨어있던 감정과 마음들을 알아주고, 목적을 상기시키니 또 다시 달려보고 싶은 마음이 이만큼 커져있네요. 

이틀 동안 너무 큰 인사이트를 얻고 돌아와서 여운도 길었던 것 같아요. 커뮤니티에 돌아와 어떤 영향을 주는 사람이 될지를 고민하는 시간까지 선물해주었네요. 

그랜드 하얏트 호텔도 좋았지만, 같은 마음을 가진 멋진 앰배서더 분들과 연결해주고 이틀이라는 시간을 빼곡히 진심을 담아 준비했을 모든 분들에게 저도 진심으로 감사의 마음을 전합니다. 

받은 사랑을 다 갚지 못하겠지만, 지역 커뮤니티에 긍정적인 영향을 주는 룰루레몬의 앰배서더가 되어볼게요.

We created an immersive portfolio site for LA-based creative strategist, @noahrabinowitz ⚡

Having worked with global brands including @Spotify, @Lululemon, @Lego, @Strava, @Sonos and more, the challenge was to highlight Noah’s strategic thinking behind his work and not just the creative output.

We came up with the concept of turning ‘thinking outside of the box’ on its head.

The site experience begins in the ether; the space between ideas. From here, three-dimensional cubes offer a first glimpse of an idea upon hover. Diving into a project ‘box’ opens the underlying project strategy - the very heart of the idea. Further, opening up the box reveals the case study, transporting the user deeper into the fully realised project.

The UI is kept to simple key-lines, a sort of schematic wireframe. Light / Dark modes allow projects to be shown in their best light, whilst hidden Easter eggs keep the tone light and on brand.

Overall, the new site balances Noah’s playful, exuberant personality with the thoughtfulness that goes into his work.

What is self-love, anyway?

Something I’m exploring a lot specifically as a man currently is the idea of self-love vs. self-ego obsession. 

As a man with a big heart who’s very emotional & sensitive, but who grew up in a culture where the men were idolized and praised by other men for having more women & things (that satisfied ego), I’ve always felt this unconscious pressure to be desired in order to feel accepted and loved, and this is where the feeling of being obsessed with ego comes in, disguised as love. If I get more, I am worthy. But that’s outdated for me now.

My manhood was based not in love and authentically expressing my gifts, but in ego obsession & external validation, and that misaligns me. 

Today I’m reflecting on what it means to love my true intentions, desires, wants, and needs void of external validation and societal/cultural pressures. I’m reflecting on the fact that to me, today, self-love means honoring what I truly have to give, freely, knowing that it’s special, regardless of who agrees or accepts. I’m reflecting & practicing feeling internally abundant with this energy first, so that it flows out of me naturally instead of artificially and conditionally.

I am love.

I am grace. 

I am grounding.

I am confidence.

I am peace.

I am strength.

Already.

And I don’t need others to validate that, yet I am grateful if others receive & accept it, but not attached, and respect boundaries if they don’t.

Our culture is shifting. We’re craving deeper relationships with ourselves and with others, and it starts with learning ourselves and feeling what’s already there in abundance, so then we feel proud to let it flow out of us, unconditionally and to express ourselves and shine freely, like the ☀️.

Today is a reminder to love and appreciate yourself, fully, AND appreciate your loved ones, because all relationships (within & out) are potential mirrors for us to grow, expand, and be more at peace, through the ease and the challenges 💚

A few years ago, I started feeling like I needed more than just teaching yoga classes

Teaching yoga classes gave me purpose, it still gives me purpose. But this feeling came from a feeling of wanting to go deeper. I was feeling like I wanted to help people in a deeper way beyond the mat. I felt like I had more to offer. 

But I didn’t know what to do, where to start. There was a hesitation and I had major creative blocks . And there was fear & imposter syndrome.

I would eventually find out why I couldn’t help people in a deeper way. 

The energy couldn’t come through because I needed to go deeper within myself first. 

I needed a hard mirror to look at my own shadows, darkness, and demons, because until we understand those, we can only go so far.

What I’ve become more aware of is how much I have craved love through external validation, while feeling ashamed of myself - that’s a crazy combination because that leads to unconscious behaviors and when people don’t give you the exact validation you seek, you try to get it by any means necessary.

My healing journey started from a series of events that showed me and completely exposed me to how much my need for external validation was killing every part of what made me special. 

I had lost my real authentic self completely and tried to continue to work harder while trying to get better at hiding my shadows. 

My shine was blocked because I was ashamed of myself, really.

And being exposed HURT. And it still hurts - but it led me to finally realizing this..

When you hide your shadows and are ashamed to look at the whole you, express yourself authentically, and love yourself fully, you will never get anywhere close to the person that you’re meant to be. There will be a conflict in you that FATIGUES you. You are tired because you are coming from behind. And you will act out of alignment from your true, shining self.

It’s learning to love myself unconditionally that I’m finding is the source of my real energy.

It’s hard to love yourself, unconditionally, shadows and all.
 BUT in doing so, it will remove blocks and unlock a confidence and energy that you’ve never felt before.

My fall 2022 race season felt a little anticlimactic after the weather in Indy was such a drag. It was one of my best training blocks ever and while I’m super proud of how I executed on that wacky day in Indy, it was nowhere near as fast as I knew I was capable of running 26.2 miles with the fitness I had.

But that’s how it goes! There are NEVER any guarantees. Boston could be crazy weather this year, too, or I could be contending with any number of other obstacles that are out of my control.

Being driven to run specific results isn’t what gets me to lace up my shoes every day anymore, thank goodness. That mindset limited me at times (I’ve run so much faster - and farther - than I would have allowed myself to imagine at one point!) and frustrated me (I’ve fallen short of number goals many times before, and let that steal my joy and stunt my growth). 

Having an enduring love for the process, believing in and enjoying the journey, prioritizing self discovery … these are some of the biggest things that sustain my drive and inspire me to keep moving forward no matter what the results are on race days.

No matter what, my biggest goal for Boston right now is to enjoy the heck out of the next 9 weeks, work hella hard and be smart about recovery. The fire is stoked 🔥 Bring it on!

10-miler in the books!

Some of the squad and I are training for a 1/2 marathon and this 10 mile race was an opportunity to see how our training is progressing.

It was right on time because I haven’t run hard for anything longer than 5k in many years, minus a 6 mile time trial in 2020.

I was a little anxious going out, not really sure what kind of pace I could hold for that distance.

The number 1 goal was to run the back 5 faster than the front 5.

I started pretty comfortable in my effort. I had some strong runners around me and felt good settling in with them early on.

The weather was awesome. The course was beautiful. I was feeling strong!

I turned to my neighbor and said “we couldn’t have asked for a better day!”

“Can’t really talk right now” he responded.

He was grinding. I took inventory of the others around me and they were all also working harder than me.

It was time to join the party and start suffering a little, so I picked up the pace.

I was still feeling strong at the higher effort, but wasn’t sure if I’d be able to hit my goal of running the second half faster.

I’m out here to see what I can do, so let’s find out! I kept pressing. My first 5 came in at 36:08 and my second at 34:49!

Hit my goal and finished with a time that feels good! 1:10:57 12th overall, 2nd in my age group.

This pic was taken somewhere in the last 2 miles, I think 😵‍💫

A few weeks until the half! Let’s go!! 💪

I sometimes get stuck in the details. One tiny thing that stops me from moving forward. I can get all the big things done but then get tripped up with some insignificant organizational component. Sometimes I can’t get over this little detail and my plans fall apart. 
There are ways around this of course. More discipline. Better organization. Beat myself. But my favourite one is an assistant so I can just let go of all of my responsibilities. Lol. 
I can’t afford an assistant so that’s not a solution. Unless I can find one that pays me to do the work. There has to be another solution. 
I bit my nails and cuticles for about 30 years. Sometimes so bad that each finger had bandaids on them from the pain. One day, I just got fed up of the pain. One day I said to myself, I’m the one causing this pain to myself. Nobody else is involved. 
Almost everything bad that has ever happened to me was caused by me. I wasn’t abused. I have been given lots in this life. I constantly throw roadblocks in front of me. 
I think I can connect these two seemingly independent things. 
One day, I’ll just get fed up of screwing up. One day when I’ve had enough failures, I’ll just decide I won’t fail. I won’t be the roadblock to my own success. I recently heard on a meme about how someone fired Oprah. I mean before Oprah was Oprah. But before she was fired. She wasn’t Oprah. At least not the one kick ass bitch we know her as. She was just some lady named Oprah. Then she had a few failures. And those failures made her stronger. One day, she said Fawk this shyte and just stopped letting the wind set her course. She went for it. 
Im starting to finally see that i can succeed too. I’m not gonna be Oprah. I’m not going to be anything close to her. She’s the best version of her. I just want to be the best version of me. The one where I go for it, whatever it is. I stop trying to detail my own success. I stop worrying about what other people think. I just stop making excuses. I’m kinda getting tired of being the thing that stops me. Instead of being my biggest ally, sometimes I’m my biggest enemy. That day is coming soon.

Can I be honest guys? It’s been a little hard for me lately. Closing Boston. My co-founder leaving the brand. The Brooklyn studio still not open. It’s taken lots of prayer and meditation and community to be able to navigate all of this with grace; while still pushing to dismantle an entire industry; while trying to be a shining example of what a purpose-driven / radically transparent black ceo in wellness can look like. So, when I went to @lululemon’s take space event I went for networking! we need instructors, i don’t really know the wellness community here…Now, you might not know this (hell, I didn’t even know until recently) - but my self esteem used to be in the trash. My aunt Flo visited from Belize once and she held my hands and said grandniece you have to learn how to love yourself and I remember staring at her blankly. Like, what does that even mean? 🥺😂 But kudos to doing the work! See, a lot of carribbean women are raised to be perfect wives - and that’s kinda it. No one ever told me I was smart growing up, I was bussed into white schools my entire childhood (I vividly remember in boarding school my bestie’s boyfriend calling me a nigger, regularly, and everyone laughing, every single time, even her. no one ever said it was wrong or that he should stop and so he didn’t. me? I lived with them and wanted to keep my life so I smiled with deference, kept my head down and did my work for years). So walking into this event, I assumed it would be another brand “trying” to connect with the culture. Hunny, I couldn’t have been more wrong. I walked in and literally felt as welcome as I feel walking into a @trill.fit space and we KNOW how rare that is 🥺 Everyone there was black (and allies too!!). The location was the iconic Harlem Parish. The conversations were *expertly* curated. I did!! get in my networking + met some of the most inspiring people that I cannot wait to spend more time with (including personal heroes of mine). And the most surprising (or unsurprising??) thing - they *ALL* knew @trill.fit and they *ALL* knew who I was 🥺😭. i was shocked!! nyc I love you. uptown I love you. @lululemon I love you. we gon’ be alright. this bhm is different ✊🏾

Double run day adventure complete! 

Started the morning with an easy 23:25 5km warmup at Puarenga parkrun with a few other runners who were then being whisked away to the start line of the @taraweraultramarathon 21km trail race. 

The Tarawera 21km was a fun race through the forests and hills around Rotorua. I had run most of this course when I did the 50km race here in 2021. It was quite humid and I had a bit of trouble keeping pace after some climbing but happy to finish in 1:49 for 46th of ~1200 on this undulating course. 

Thanks so much to Puarenga parkrun event director Alison King @runswithabarcode who had her getaway car ready when we crossed the finish line. We made it with plenty of time to spare. 

The biggest thanks always to my biggest supporter Jamie @sou.desu.ne for picking me up at the finish line.

Today started off feeling like a tough one.

I felt the weight of the past tugging on the strings of my shame and I found myself really wishing I handled certain things differently.

I even found myself feeling resentment towards Life for not giving me what I want and not conceding to exactly how I want things to play out.

I’m like, “okay Life, I hear you. I feel the pain. I get it. Can I have what I want now? Can you give me something to make me not feel this anymore?”

But the biggest lessons don’t work like that. 

The big ones need to settle all the way the f*** in, so the lesson and the change shifts you at a fundamental level. It’s gotta infiltrate your nervous system and shake you up so you understand DEEPLY, because pain is a great teacher.

And then in meditating and then writing this, practicing raw acceptance of my feelings, I started to feel a subtle & building intuitive touch of acceptance that I’m exactly where I’m supposed to be.

And I started to feel lighter, had a moment of clarity, and celebrated the acceptance as a breakthrough.

And so I leave you with this..

The progress isn’t always in getting what you want right now, seeing results right now, or even feeling better right this second. 

SOMETIMES, the progress is in continuing to sit in the discomfort and CONTINUE to be willing to be taught while uncomfortable, because the lesson might not be just a class, but a whole damn semester.

You’re exactly where you need to be, and CONTINUED ACCEPTANCE is a BREAKTHROUGH. Keep digging into it. It will make sense.

Aastey is a 2020 launch that offers sustainable sportswear for all women, regardless of size. Aastey is making waves in the athleisure industry by developing the first sustainable and size-inclusive leggings in India and connecting with more than 60,000 women across cities.

The distinction between fashionable street clothing and cosy workout attire has become more hazy thanks to athleisure. And while many Indian brands have introduced sportswear to fulfil the demands of this expanding industry, very few are able to live up to consumer expectations in terms of fabric quality and size inclusivity.

To compete with global powerhouses like Lululemon, Nike, Adidas, and Gymshark, Jeevika Tyagi and Kanupriya Mundhra have taken on the challenge of creating an Indian sustainable athleisure brand for women.

According to its founders, Mumbai-based aastey, which was established in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, is the nation's first D2C (direct-to-consumer) firm to successfully manufacture recycled polyester clothing. The start-up provides a variety of products, including yoga mats, eye masks, tote bags, leggings, and sports bras.

What helps you get through hard times? 🧘🏼‍♀️

One of my favorite ways to get my mind right is to write in a journal. Here, I have the ability to get into a flow state as I write all of my thoughts down. It allows me to have a visual of what is going on, such as my fears, anxieties, and overall emotions. I am able to have an open conversation with myself, which gives me clarity about what I need to work on. Once I am able to figure out the problems, I then try to figure out how to overcome them and move forward. It also helps me reframe my mind. For example, once I write down what I am upset about, I often write down a list of everything I am grateful for to counter it. 

I also utilize journals for my goals. Writing everything down gives an outline of what I want to accomplish, and I can then break that down into little goals to accomplish. By minimizing a huge goal, it becomes more attainable. Each day I write down tasks to complete, and over time that compounds into achieving a larger goal.

Besides goals and overcoming mental blocks, I also use it for drawing, writing and affirmations. These just come to me at the moment, and it feels like an "out of body, out of mind" experience. I allow myself to just be in the moment, and let the pen flow. This flow state I have talked about becomes a sort of meditation for me, and I can get lost here for quite some time. These sometimes end up becoming blogs, social media posts, or inspiration for art and other projects. 

What helps you? How do you get into a flow state?

YOU ARE ENOUGH & YOU ARE WORTHY.

One of the challenging things about self-love, and self-worthiness is that we’re born into this world with complete dependence on others. As a baby, and as a child, our sense of belonging, trust, and confidence comes from those who raise us (or don’t, too).

This then gets stored in our subconscious and becomes our base way of relating to the world.

If we experience such feelings as abandonment, or shame, or lack of trust, or confusion, for example, these become the basis for feeling unworthy or not enough and become part of the wiring of our subconscious mind.

& If we don’t understand our unconscious mind and where our thinking, feeling, and reaction patterns are coming from, our intentions won’t be strong enough and we’ll always fall short of our potential, feeling stuck and…unworthy.

I know what it feels like to have my REAL shine and blessings being BLOCKED by feelings of unworthiness developed from past events. 

These feelings create insecurity, instability, and an overall ANXIETY that you need to PROVE yourself in order to feel worthy of love, in any form, even from yourself.

And this anxiety creates a LACK OF PRESENCE that doesn’t FULLY allow you to develop the skills of your purpose, or appreciate what’s in front of you, or learn from challenge, or be intimate enough to create real depth, or even have the energy to do the work needed - because unconsciously, there’s a belief that you’re not worthy of love, change, growth, energy, ease, etc TO BEGIN WITH.

Can you relate in some way?

So it becomes absolutely necessary to develop a practice of CHOOSING to see your value and your worthiness. DAILY.

Like, this is STEP ONE.

Close your eyes. Breathe deep. Feel the energy you get to create with. It’s our responsibility.

You are ENOUGH. You HAVE it. You are WORTHY of love, of growth, of change, of ease, of appreciation, of WORK, of success, of evolving, of all of it.

Know this. Feel this. Because I’m reminding you, your LIFE depends on it.

A more than 1500 page report obtained by FOX23 lists thousands of transactions made by former Osage Casinos CEO Byron Bighorse. The expenses were all approved by the tribe’s Gaming Enterprise Board.

“$1,800 bottles of scotch, beluga caviar,” Tillman said. “They bought new clothes almost every time they went to the country club.”

Records show he even expensed a parking ticket with tribal funds and also spent nearly $2,500 on “antique brass coins.”
“The Osage people were robbed,” Tillman said.

Nobody left behind: Why fashion should strive for a ‘just transition’
Fashion could learn a lot from the closure of coal mines when it comes to coupling social and environmental impact,l.But the process of a just transition is complex, and requires a radical mindset shift many brands are reluctant to embrace. 

The term first emerged in the 1960s, when big corporations began acquiring small, family-run coal mines to improve efficiency in the face of increasing competition from oil and natural gas. Many were closed, affecting communities that relied on them for their livelihoods, and trade unions had to step in to protect worker rights. The concept was formalised at the 1997 Kyoto Conference and was widely adopted beyond the energy sector from 2010 onwards. 2015 was another turning point, when the Paris Climate Agreement stated that the transition to a low-carbon economy must be done in just ways.

Only 19 per cent of companies were able to demonstrate financial support for factories decarbonising: American Eagle Outfitters, Columbia Sportswear, Gap Inc., Kering, Levi Strauss & Co., Lululemon, Puma, Ralph Lauren, Reformation and Target. 

Perhaps most importantly, brands need to redress the power imbalances permeating supply chains. Brands will need to put suppliers and key supply chain managers on the board in future.

International Labour Organization (ILO) anticipates that extreme heat alone will render millions of jobs impossible in the next few decades, but it is already affecting supply chains, including cotton production in Egypt and Uzbekistan, and garment manufacturing in India and Bangladesh. “Those impacts will just get worse unless we manage to limit global warming to 1.5°C.”

In the @glossyco article, @jillmanoff briefs us on the recent changes in the activewear market, moving far beyond just leggings. 

The line between the “apparel” and “activewear” categories has increasingly blurred. Brands that have managed to cut through the noise have leaned on influencers to promote their products’ versatility and trend-driven aesthetic. 

According to @launchmetrics' data, @lululemon dominated activewear buzz in 2022. However, 73% of its Media Impact Value™ of $233 Million was driven by mentions in traditional media, including print publications. Just 19%, or $44 Million, was generated by influencers. 

Meanwhile, influencers drove $51 million in MIV® for @aloyoga, helping to sell its products as being suitable outside of the gym. A single Instagram post by @georginagio wearing an Alo pullover has generated $2.3 million in MIV® for the brand.

The type of energy that you put out there is the type of energy that you attract. If you’re constantly putting yourself down, being negative, complaining, those are the type of people that are going to surround you. The type of people that are going to bring you down, not support you, not want to see you grow, etc.

This is why it’s so important to get rid of negative people in your life so that you can grow and become your best. There are people that will hold you back, pretend they support you for constantly feed you negative energy please no that you are worth more , and deserve better!

1. Know when it’s time to move on. You can’t make somebody change.
2. Find someone who values you for who you are, not for who they want you to become.
3. Love yourself first. If you’re not happy with yourself, you are absolutely not going to attract the right type of person.
4. There’s nothing wrong with being alone. Not everyone is meant to have a partner.
5. Most of all, learn to forgive yourself. No one is perfect. Everyone has messed up at some point in their life. The most important thing is that you improve yourself going forward.

It's pretty common to first arrive on the yoga mat expecting to increase flexibility. If you're new to practicing with me, you'll quickly realize that we do A LOT more than stretch to increase range of motion. If you practice with me or in a similar style, you'll build strength, balance, and focus. Strength and flexibility are not mutually exclusive, nor are they at odds--they work together and support one another. 

What happens if all we do is stretch a muscle group? The muscle group will most likely weaken. A balance between strengthening and lengthening on the mat helps cultivate healthy tissues and a balanced body. A balance between active range of motion stretching and passive range of motion stretching supports joint stability and healthy connective tissues. 

Years ago when I first stumbled into the practice, my body wasn't just tight and stiff, it was weak in so many places. An active and balanced practice has increased my flexibility for sure, but more importantly; it's made me stronger than I've ever been. That strength building component not only supports fun stuff like inversions and arm balances, but translates to other physical activities, daily life, and overall health.

Want to get stronger? Reach out to me, I love working one-on-one with people to customize a practice that works for YOU. 💞✨

過去如果你看到我穿著這身，你估計會問我：「今天要拍廣告嗎？」、「今天是不是有什麼特別活動？」、當然還有「今天要去參加婚禮喔？」（大笑🤣）如今，這身裝扮已經是我的OOTD，反而可能很難見到我穿著瑜伽服穿梭在街上的身影。你的下一個問題可能是：「所以現在Lemon不教瑜伽了嗎？」教的。我仍是瑜伽老師，但又不僅僅是瑜伽老師！
記得這個粉絲專頁創立之初2015年時，我是位小廣告演員、平面模特兒。在2017年，開始了數位3.0的全球改革，從平面的2D內容轉換為平台上的直播、預錄節目。同時又開始與lululemon有了品牌大使的長年合作。直到了2020年，我們迎來了改變世界的covid。許多人在我這次回台問我，我們有多久不見了？三年？我笑著回答說其實只有一年半，但這一年半裡，我們的生命裡發生了太多變化，才感覺有種時空平行的錯過感、又或者還來不及反應！
.
自從開始研讀占星學後，漸漸了解上升、天頂、下降這些更精微的量值，他們不像太陽、月亮、上升這種被我解讀為本我、自我和超我的自我議題，而是與婚姻、情感、家人相關的話題。不免俗的寫到這裡，就得要和大家介紹一個不能算新身份，更該說是新責任。父母其實在我未出生前，就已經在醫療體系工作。當然醫療體系有很龐大的分支以及細部的專業分工，有機會再多聊這塊。因緣際會下，在我國小的時候其實就到中國大陸創業，所以如果是從我小時候一起長大的同學們，都知道我爸媽長期不在台灣，這也造就了我很獨立也很自主的部分性格。
以往我們是一年三會，但因爲當時的Covid，兩位老人家忍受不了這麼長時間的來回隔離，便詢問我是否有想要過去找他們（當然還是有一些威逼利誘。），言而總之，就過去了。殊不知，這只是算盤中的一計（是的！他們真的是有權謀算計的父母。NO KIDDING，但很可愛XD）在我二十出頭歲時，一邊豐厚著自己的羽毛，一邊和許多父母的利益關係人有交集。當時以為只是一些日常的交際，卻是父母有意的安排。到了中國大陸，才有種夢醒了的感覺：「啊～原來如此，是這麼大的一盤棋。」還是要再次感謝我那兩位用心良苦的父母。
.
於是乎，我也就接手了部分的公司改革工作。醫療業其實是個傳統產業（我相信從業者們應該點頭如搗蒜吧！）2B/2G就是我的日常，當然我熟悉的議題操作、社群操作等，也成為了醫療公關的工作範疇。所以我的title從過去的瑜伽老師、社群影響力者又多了ＯＯ公司執行總監和品牌長。好，我知道你看到這裡，你可能會想要恭喜我（我相信看到這裡的都會是真心愛我的人）：「Lemon你現在好棒！好厲害！」我先謝絕這個讚美，因為到這個位子才發現：我是這麼多人成就起來的。
所以我想反過來說：謝謝你！
也因此，當我重新思考起，未來要用什麼樣的方式再次以瑜伽和你們這些愛我的人連結；又或者說我們已經不僅有在瑜伽教室可以相聚，我們還有更多可能性的相聚方式能使用時，我能如何提供真正適用於在已非昨日的明日？因此有了即將的這個系列，【我與我的故事：啟程】因為我真摯地相信，我們的相遇與相知，都創造了屬於我們自己的故事，那些故事有我、有別人，但最重要的是：有你自己！

3: I want to highlight some of my favorite parts of these movements. 

📝: Slide 1: Crazy lateral core and adductor work. 

📝: Slide 2: I almost always use chin up grip as it glides smoother for my shoulders... obviously since they are in a different position than pull-ups. And I’m better at them with a supinated or neutral grip since it kinda changes what muscles are working harder. 

📝: Slide 3: Again, I am always training out of all planes of motion & movement. Too often neglected.

Yoga at the surface, can be seen as exercise and physical improvement. And it is that. But also, it’s about self-love. Unconditional self-love.

And the truth is, an honest yoga practice isn’t always about just feeling good. It’s about hearing truth.

For real peace and growth, you have to learn to accept yourself unconditionally - strengths & “flaws.”

& accepting yourself unconditionally means learning to see not only the parts of you that you like, but your shadows as well. Accepting your shadows gives you a chance to understand them and change them.

“Showing ourselves grace” isn’t about letting ourselves off the hook but instead learning to look at our shadows and shame with love and a willingness to understand that they were put there because we were once hurt and we just don’t wanna hurt again. That’s understandable.

But if we know and understand that discomfort & pain are great teachers, then, with love, we can understand & THANK our shadows for trying to protect us, and THEN give ourselves permission to step into discomfort, grow, and then be activated by our purpose, instead of controlled by our fears.

So if you get triggered in any way today, may you practice PAUSING, may you practice REMEMBERING that your body has a natural avoidance to pain and that’s why it freaks out when you get triggered, BUT, may you take a DEEP breath, show yourself (real) GRACE, and then LEAN in to the lesson the the spiritual boss you are.

After @nike sued @bape_japan, they are now suing @lululemon 👀

For everyone who isn’t aware, Nike is *finally* suing BAPE after nearly two decades and is asking for three times the amount of compensatory damages.
Most of you know what BAPE is, but if you don’t, it’s the Japanese streetwear brand created in 1993 by @nigo and its cultural influence is undeniable. The BAPE STA is the model in question. The silhouette first popped up in the early 2000s and is a direct riff on the Air Force.

So why now❓ BAPE for years sold redesigned Bapestas that looked less like Nike Air Force 1s. Nike says in lawsuit that the new Bapestas (slide 3, from 2022) return to the "initial infringing design." + they opened brick-and-mortar stores, selling more BAPE STA’s and marketed as hard as ever in the U.S. starting around 2021.

Only five days after seeking legal action against BAPE, Nike zeroes on its next target: Lululemon—claiming they are infringing on their patented footwear designs and the innovative Flyknit technology.

📝 It’s important to note that Nike also sued brands like #adidas, #PUMA and #Skechers in the past for violating its patents as it pertains to its Flyknit technology.

Toula: “Ah, the man is the head of the house!"

Maria: “The man is the head, but the woman is the neck. And she can turn the head any way she wants.”

Wise words from 𝙈𝙮 𝘽𝙞𝙜 𝙁𝙖𝙩 𝙂𝙧𝙚𝙚𝙠 𝙒𝙚𝙙𝙙𝙞𝙣𝙜. Meet Jessica, the other Siciliano…the Mrs…the better half! 😉

A dynamic duo indeed. We have a lot of new friends here and since Charlie shared a bit about himself and an incredible recap of our journey a few posts back, I’ll move right along!

I’ve been selling real estate for almost 9 years. Before that, I worked for a real estate lawyer for years and also worked in retail, including stores like Louis Vuitton, Saks, Lululemon, and Build-A-Bear. 🧸 Didn’t see that last one comin’, did ya? Me neither…worst job ever. I was 15 and I quit after a few weeks. 😂 R.I.P. stuffed bears that wear ridiculously expensive clothes and shoes. 🥴

I love what I do. I’m an extroverted introvert. I’m a Leo - loyal, loving, leader and loud. 🙃 I grew up in Berkley. I’m Lebanese, (38% ironically and I had no idea…I’ve never met anyone from my Dad’s side of the family), Irish, Italian, German and Belgian. I think that basically means I tan AND burn in the sun, I love pasta, I have a temper and I have naturally really curly hair. 🤷🏼‍♀️

I used to freelance makeup for weddings and special events. I love fashion, fast cars, nature, Halloween and Emma Roberts. 💁🏼‍♀️ I’m madly in love with our two pups Mocha and Mack and I thank God EVERY single day for giving me Charlie. Truly, he’s my best friend, my rock, role model, the most loving husband, and he makes me a better person in every way. People ask me how I can work with my husband…I couldn’t work with anyone else. 🫶

Thanks for following our day-to-day adventures - sit back, relax and enjoy the show! 🍿

Chantée Dardaine (she/her) is a Registered Psychotherapist, Founder of SelfCareTO & Yoga Teacher. Chantee's practice is rooted in providing accessible, approachable and affordable therapy. She works towards creating safe and trusting relationships with her clients providing them with a place to be seen and heard. Chantee offers trauma informed, culturally adaptive and gender affirming approaches to meet the diverse needs of her clients and uses therapeutic modalities like EMDR, IFS, Somatic processing, breathwork and meditation.

The blueprint of Pilates has taught Jennifer that less is more and mind-body connection will give you superpowers. 「當你真心渴望某件事時，全宇宙都會聯合起來幫助你。」—《牧羊少年奇幻之旅》

某天在思考該如何在台灣推廣正念呢？第一個想到的是與品牌合作。

想到這個方向後隔一天，因為我哥要生日的關係，我打開google 搜尋花店，希望可以買束鮮花送給他，當下只搜尋到新光三越裡面有花店。

抵達新光三越的花店，發現也沒有理想的鮮花，只好搭手扶梯準備離開，就在下一層樓後，看到了Lululemon 的專櫃，好奇的想看看櫃上的衣服。

「請問這件有其他顏色嗎？」看見一位身旁Lululemon 的櫃上員工，我問。

這位員工當下認出了戴口罩的我，她叫Miu Miu，她很開心的告訴我，曾經我在網路上有送書，她剛好有拿到一本叫《靈魂的出生前計劃》。

「喔～這本是我曾經在徒步環島的時候，在民宿書架上讀到的一本的書。」我說。

聊著聊著說到Lululemon 會策劃一些課程是給員工體驗的課，講著講著就說好了不久的未來也會為Lululemon來開一堂正念生活的分享。

今天早上當為Lululemon 帶完課後，想起這堂課的發生，從一個起心動念願能推廣正念給更多的人，到從來不逛百貨公司的我，遇到了Miu Miu。

都聽說過當給予後會有回報，但是曾經送書的當下並沒有想得到什麼回報，就只是單純的分享自己喜歡的書給有緣的人。

而宇宙在最好的時間點，把一本書的緣份延續到一堂正念的推廣。

不知道推廣的路會如何走下去，但相信越渴望一件事情的發生，宇宙會提供所需要的資源。

祝福💛

（當打完這篇的最後一個字，立即就收到了新的正念推廣合作的邀約😆好妙）

I talk about body image a lot. 
A lot. A lot.

And it is a rare day that abdomens are not part of the conversation.

As if human abdomens are intended to look like the bellies in a Lululemon or Victoria’s Secret ad. Even the with the subtle shift in bellies that are being used to advertise clothing and (sometimes) fitness/wellness industry goods. As if those bellies actually look that way, anyway. And maybe they do, but yours doesn’t have to.

As if your favorite influencer doesn’t have the ability to edit and curate the appearance of the tummy you compare yours to.

Normal belly experiences:
Feeling soft.
Looking soft.
Feeling squishy.
Looking squishy.
Feeling bloated.
Looking bloated.
Feeling one way in the morning.
Looking one way in the morning.
Feeling differently at the end of the day. Looking differently at the end of the day.

A gentle reminder: your digestive organs work all day long. As that is happening, it is to be expected that your belly experiences change, throughout the day. Also, gravity exists. Muscles in your trunk, or belly region, work hard to hold your organs in place. By the end of the day, gravity has pulled on those muscles. So it makes sense that your belly change from morning to night. Not that you need a rationale for an abdomen that changes. But this is a reality that will never change, for as long as you are on this planet.
 
Gravity has staying power. Idealized tummies? Not so much.

For your reflection:
How has focusing on your abdomen impacted the way you have felt about or in your body?
Where did you learn that your tummy was a problem?
When did you learn that lesson?
How much time would you get back if you focused less on your tummy?

You are a whole body. 
Not sections of a body. 
Your body is good. 
Your belly is good.
.
.
Has tummy focus occupied your time? Has tummy focus harmed or enhanced your body experience?
👍/👎
.
